sloka: कौसल्ये चित्त मोहेन हृदयम् सीदतीव मे ।वेदये न च समुक्तान् शब्दस्पर्शरसानहम् ॥२-६४-७३॥
transliteration: kausalye citta mohena hṛdayam sīdatīva me ।vedaye na ca samuktān śabdasparśarasānaham ॥2-64-73॥

translations.english: O Kausalya, my heart, it appears is sinking and on account of delusion I am not able to feel the sense objects like sound touch and taste together.
